newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian bonds finally draw profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian bonds finally draw profit-taking.

text.p: *Australian bonds finally succumbed to light profit-taking after a fairly firm week which has seen its yield differential to the U.S. narrow to its lowest level in over two years.
*Market also taking a cautious tone ahead of the FOMC.
Australian bonds finally succumbed to light profit-taking after a fairly firm week which has seen its yield differential to the U.S. narrow to its lowest level in over two years, traders said.

"The market had got itself a little long and if you have been a bull in outright terms this week you haven't seen a lot of price action," one trader said. "I think the market is taking a cautionary stance ahead of the FOMC (meeting next Tuesday)."
However, the market has held up extremely well despite local supply and against a backdrop of falling U.S. bonds, which took the 10-year yield spread to the U.S. down to 106 basis points.
This spread low was seen in after hours trading and compares with around 129 basis points on Monday.

Meanwhile, PUMA Management Ltd priced its A$500 million of fixed and floating securitised bonds this morning, adding to the A$700 million Treasury bond tender on Tuesday and the A$100 million offering from Queensland Treasury Corp on Thursday.
U.S. Treasuries steadied slightly in Tokyo trading after falling again in New York after further data fanned fears that the Federal Reserve will tighten policy when the FOMC meets on September 24.

After its flurry below 110 basis points the Australian/U.S. 10-year spread eked back out to stand unchanged from Thursday's close. The market slightly underperformed Canadian debt, while a firm New Zealand market continued to claw back the sharp spread widening against the dollar bloc seen earlier in the week.
The minor retracement on the 10-year bond futures contract is currently putting pressure on a two-week upward trendline after continuing to find resistance at 92.060/92.080.
